<h1 class="gb-headline gb-headline-3656fb7e gb-headline-text">Wave Riding Kite Camp Coronation Beach</h1>

			<div id="product-7583" class="kadence-woo-template-wrap post-7583 product type-product status-publish has-post-thumbnail product_cat-tours sales-flash-overlay woocommerce-text-align-center wc-related-upsell-columns-4 wc-related-upsell-tablet-columns-2 wc-related-upsell-mobile-columns-1 do-quantity-buttons wc-has-gallery first instock shipping-taxable purchasable product-type-variable has-default-attributes">
				<div class="gb-container gb-container-3bf1432c"><div class="gb-inside-container">
<div class="kwt-breadcrumbs-wrap kwt-breadcrumbs-_73e388-53 kwt-link-style-hover_underline kwt-breadcrumbs-single wp-block-kadence-wootemplate-blocks-breadcrumbs"><nav class="woocommerce-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb"><a href="https://sharkbaykitesurfing.com">Home</a>&nbsp;&#47;&nbsp;<a href="https://sharkbaykitesurfing.com/product-category/tours/">Tours</a>&nbsp;&#47;&nbsp;Wave Riding Kite Camp Coronation Beach</nav></div>
<div class="kwt-description-wrap kwt-description-_f74d19-20 kwt-description-single woo-descriptions wp-block-kadence-wootemplate-blocks-description"><div class="gb-container gb-container-2893a739"><div class="gb-inside-container">
<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-b57f9e3a gb-headline-text heading-subline">WELCOME TO GERALDTON, WESTERN AUSTRALIA<br>KITESURFING CAMP, WAVE RIDING/FREESTYLE CLINICS AND DOWNWINDERS IN THE WINDIEST SPOT OF WA​</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From September to April, Coronation Beach Western Australia, offers top quality Wind and Waves conditions welcoming windsurfers and Kite surfers from the 4 corners of the world.​</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Warm water, hot weather, consistent strong wind and quality swells make this place a MUST Travel kite destination. ​</p>
</div></div>
<div class="gb-container gb-container-66fac095 alignwide"><div class="gb-inside-container">
<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-84ed28ed gb-headline-text">“ALL INCLUDED” DOWNWINDERS KITESURFING TRIP​<br>FOR INTERMEDIATE AND ADVANCED RIDERS​</h2>
<p class="gb-headline gb-headline-8c6345ad gb-headline-text"><strong>KITEWEST WATER SPORTS AND SHARK BAY KITESURFING HAVE LINKED UP AND INVITE YOU TO JOIN ONE OF OUR KITESURFING CAMP IN GERALDTON – CORONATION BEACH.</strong></p>
<p class="gb-headline gb-headline-103d5379 gb-headline-text"><strong>​7 DAYS OF WAVE RIDING, FREERIDE, FREESTYLE CLINICS AND DOWNWINDERS.​</strong></p>
<p class="gb-headline gb-headline-e1894b09 gb-headline-text"><strong>13-20 OCTOBER 2024​</strong><br><strong>18-25 OCTOBER 2025​</strong></p>
</div></div>

<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-e0237e53 gb-headline-text heading-subline">How to get to Geraldton Western Australia?​</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">Fly to Perth International or Domestic airport</p>
<div class="gb-grid-wrapper gb-grid-wrapper-f3569061">
<div class="gb-grid-column gb-grid-column-140c18fa">
<div class="gb-container gb-container-140c18fa">
<div class="gb-inside-container">
<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-be9f9be4"><span class="gb-headline-text">Fly to Geraldton</span></h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From Perth (PER) Domestic​<br />To ​<br />Geraldton (GET)​</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">1 hours ​</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">​Free Airport pick up​</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="gb-grid-column gb-grid-column-20595fc7">
<div class="gb-container gb-container-20595fc7">
<div class="gb-inside-container">
<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-cabc95e1"><span class="gb-headline-text">Drive to Geraldton</span></h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From Perth​<br />To ​<br />Geraldton​</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">5 hours or 440 kms​</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No 4WD required</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="gb-grid-column gb-grid-column-f1d22004">
<div class="gb-container gb-container-f1d22004">
<div class="gb-inside-container">
<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-2ff3d4ea"><span class="gb-headline-text">Bus to Geraldton</span></h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From East Perth Terminal​<br />To ​<br />Geraldton ​</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">​6 hours​</p>

<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-7d2e956f gb-headline-text">Not yet into Kitesurfing? Not a problem ​</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our tours welcome individual, families and any confident riders as of 12 years old. ​If you are just starting, willing to learn or up-skill your style, our dedicated team of instructors will tailor a beginner or improver kitesurfing course for you. By the end of the week, your first downwinder will be such a reward!​​</p>
<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-6338db84 gb-headline-text">Not travelling with your kite gear or don’t have equipment yet? Not a problem ​</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you prefer to travel light or are new to the sport, we offer top of the range kiteboarding equipment rental. Brand new or secondhand equipment purchase is also an option. ​Just contact us and we will discuss/organise it for you.​</p>
